Main Duties And Responsibilities Act as a subject matter expert for Apple solutions, supporting sales and partners throughout the pre-sales cycle. Develop and maintain strong relationships with Apple regional teams, ecosystem partners, and key enterprise accounts. Position Requirements Education
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Job Title Pre-Sales Engineer - Apple Solutions Job Scope The Pre-Sales Engineer is responsible for providing technical expertise and solution design in support of the Sales team, partners, and customers. Position Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or any other related field. Experience 5–7 years of experience in pre-sales engineering, technical consulting, or enterprise IT. Languages: Fluent in English; proficiency in Arabic and French is a plus.
